maya (eng-platform): quick sync — we need to standardize how client-visible statuses map to routing/rollout gates for BETA model variants. Console currently badges some routes as 'degraded' but clients are getting 503s or 200+warning. This is confusing.
zack (eng-platform): do you mean tenant soft-quota + route-level failover behavior? or the SDK surface too?
maya (eng-platform): both. Example: when dedicated pool is under pressure we fail to variant-b, but the SDK sometimes sees a 503 and retries; other times we return 200 with partial content and an `x-redwood-status: degraded` header.
elena (eng-runtime): runtime note: internals track `internal_status` and we emit `http_status` based on policy today. Returning 200+degraded header avoids client retry storms but can break caches and some apps that only check HTTP code.
raj (product): product POV: want predictable SDK behavior. propose 4 consumer-visible buckets: OK, DEGRADED (no retry), SOFT_FAIL (retryable, short backoff), HARD_FAIL (terminal). Console should show badges and rollout gates for each route/variant.
sophia (eng-sre): telemetry angle: for alerting/gradeboard we need a single canonical error key for aggregation — combine `http_status` + `route_variant` + `failure_mode` into `error_key`. sampling rules for high-QPS tenants so we don't blow storage.
maya (eng-platform): here's a minimal config idea for the route policy we could expose in console/SDK docs:
```
route_policy: {
  variant: "b",
  failover: ["a","fallback-cpu"],
  surface: {
    ok: {http:200},
    degraded: {http:200, header: "x-redwood-status: degraded", client_retry: false},
    soft_fail: {http:429, client_retry: true, retry_after: 2},
    hard_fail: {http:503, client_retry: false}
  }
}
```
zack (eng-platform): I like explicit surface options. runtime needs to map `surface.*` -> kernel/action. question: do we let customers choose header vs http-code for DEGRADED? elena: kernel-level tradeoffs: header-only is simple but we must stop downstream CDNs from caching if traffic is sensitive. add `cache_control: no-store` for degraded responses.
raj (product): console UX: add a toggle per-route for `degraded_mode_strategy` with two choices: "surface-warning" (200+header) or "signal-fail" (non-2xx). default = "surface-warning" for Hosted, "signal-fail" for Dedicated unless customer opts in.
sophia (eng-sre): rollout gating: expose a rule that if error_key rate > X% over Y minutes then auto-roll back variant and notify on-call. Also emit a metric `redwood.client_exposed_status` with tags [tenant,route,variant,surface].
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout of variant-b to 5% started (build 2026.03.18-rc4)
zack (eng-platform): telemetry/SDK contract: propose we add `sdk.status` enum mapping to our buckets (OK, DEGRADED, SOFT_FAIL, HARD_FAIL) so SDKs can handle deterministic behavior instead of parsing headers.
maya (eng-platform): action items: (1) eng-runtime implement `surface` mapping + `cache_control` flag, (2) eng-platform + product spec console toggle labels, (3) eng-sre add `error_key` aggregator + alert rule, (4) SDKs add `sdk.status` enum. who wants to pick up (1)?
elena (eng-runtime): i'll take (1). estimate 3 days to prototype.
sophia (eng-sre): i'll draft alert rule and example alerting thresholds today.
raj (product): i'll craft the console copy and two-state UX mock by EOD Thurs.
zack (eng-platform): i'll update the docs and draft the SDK contract. tagging @maya once I have a PR.
maya (eng-platform): thanks — will follow up in a PR and link to gradeboard playbook. :thumbsup:
